# Nikola Djurovic, full profile

> Long-form companion to https://nikoladjurovic.cv/llms.txt. Everything here is also published as HTML on the site. Last updated 2026-10-07.

> Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner based in Belgrade, Serbia (CET), working freelance. Takes B2B contracts with clients worldwide, remote; full-time roles considered. Six years on SPQ+, SKF's global CPQ (configure, price, quote) platform used in 160+ countries, delivered through Soprex: 300+ specifications, launches held at 0 critical defects.

Contact: nikoladjurovic21@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikoladjurovic · Website: https://nikoladjurovic.cv/

## Key facts

- Role: Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner at Soprex since 2022 (Mid-Level Business Analyst 2021 to 2022, Junior Business Analyst 2020 to 2021), working on SKF's SPQ+ platform.
- Leads the BA team at Soprex and manages two development teams (around 15 people).
- 300+ functional and non-functional specifications delivered (BRD, SRS, HLE).
- Release planning across 5 cross-functional teams and 10+ workstreams; launches held at 0 critical defects.
- Specified the 0 to 1 Approval Web Application, live in 160+ countries: multi-tier sign-off, SOX and ISO 9001 traceability, REST API contracts for SAP, Salesforce and Snowflake.
- Specified and delivered the platform's first AI agent: a voice-command assistant on an LLM layer across OpenAI, Gemini and Grok, with provider switching and fallback.
- Led AI adoption in the BA team: Claude Cowork ticket creation, MCP connections into Jira and ServiceNow, usage guidelines and training for about 50 users. Time per specification fell by about 32%.
- 2026: rolled out Jira Cloud to 50+ users, 10,000+ tickets and hundreds of projects; wrote a Jira Forge app in Node.js with 95 unit tests.
- Booking.dentist (2021 to 2023, via Soprex): sole BA and PO on a two-sided B2B/B2C medical-tourism marketplace live in 35+ countries. Shipped two products 0 to 1, wrote the business case, KPIs, MVP roadmap and pitch decks behind EUR 250,000 in seed funding raised through Katapult, cut 348 hours of non-MVP scope, built the sales function with the CEO (10-person team). Revenue grew 30%+ during his time.
- Earlier: Sales Development Representative at Sales Clover (2020), Market Research Analyst at Cloudleaf, Inc. (2018).
- Education: B.A. Ethnology and Anthropology, University of Belgrade, 2019. CBAP (IIBA) in progress.
- Languages: Serbian native, English C2, Spanish A2.

## Services

- Requirements and specifications: workshops, gap analysis, BRD, SRS, HLE, user stories with acceptance criteria, requirements traceability (RTM).
- Process design: AS-IS and TO-BE BPMN, business rules, use cases, UML.
- Product ownership: backlog, MoSCoW / RICE / WSJF prioritisation, release planning, UAT.
- Integration analysis: REST API contracts, payloads and data mapping between any systems (ERP, CRM, commerce, data platforms). Delivered for SAP, Salesforce, Snowflake and SAP CPI.
- AI adoption and integration for businesses: finding where AI pays off, specifying LLM features and agents, connecting AI to business tools over MCP, and rolling it out across departments with usage guidelines and staff training. Evidence: the SPQ+ AI agent, OpenClaw integrated at Soprex with the technical team, and a BA-team rollout with about 50 users trained and about 32% less time per spec.
- Product strategy and fundraising: Mom Test discovery, MVP scope, KPIs, roadmap, business case, investor pitch decks.

## Engagement

- Freelance B2B contract, invoiced monthly through his registered business in Serbia. No sponsorship or relocation needed.
- Remote for clients worldwide, with hours shifted to overlap with the client's team, or on-site and hybrid in Belgrade. Can start within 2 weeks of signing.
- Rates are shared on request, after an intro call or by email.

### Profile

Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner, 6+ years on the global CPQ platform of a Fortune 500 manufacturer, used in 160+ countries. Runs stakeholder workshops, models processes in BPMN and writes the specs engineering builds from, then takes each feature through test cases, UAT, release with DevOps and hypercare. 300+ specifications, launches held at 0 critical defects, and AI tooling that cut time per spec by about 32%.

## FAQ

### How do you work with clients abroad?

As an independent contractor. I invoice monthly through my registered business in Serbia, so we sign a B2B services contract. No employment, sponsorship or relocation is involved.

### Which hours do you work?

I am based in Belgrade (CET) and work with clients worldwide. I shift my hours so your team gets a daily overlap.

### What will I have at the end of an engagement?

Documents your engineers and testers can use without me in the room: SRS or HLE, BPMN diagrams, wireframes, user stories with acceptance criteria and a traceability matrix. The Order Risk Hold work sample shows the format.

### Which tools do you use?

Jira and Confluence for delivery, Draw.io, Lucidchart, Miro and Figma for diagrams and wireframes, Postman for APIs and Power BI for reporting. I use Claude Code and Claude Cowork every day, and I check every output before it goes out under my name.

### Do you take full-time roles?

Yes, for the right team: remote, or on-site and hybrid in Belgrade. Freelance B2B contracts are my default.

### How much do you charge?

Rates depend on the engagement and scope, so I share them on the intro call or by email. Email nikoladjurovic21@gmail.com.

### When can you start?

Within 2 weeks of signing, often sooner.

## Work sample: Order Risk Hold System Design Document

Source: https://nikoladjurovic.cv/work/order-risk-hold/ (PDF: https://nikoladjurovic.cv/files/Order_Risk_Hold_SDD_Nikola_Djurovic.pdf)

Problem: Shopify's fraud verdict never reaches the ERP, so orders flagged as high risk are shipped. The document specifies storing the risk data on the Sales Order, holding high and medium risk orders from delivery, and auditing every release.

Requirements:

- FR-01: The import stores the Shopify risk assessments, the risk facts and the Shopify recommendation on the imported Sales Order.
- FR-02: The ERP derives a single Risk Level per order from the assessments, using the highest severity returned.
- FR-03: An order with Risk Level High or Medium is set to status Risk Hold at import.
- FR-04: A user cannot create a shipment for an order on hold at High risk.
- FR-05: A user can create a shipment for an order on hold at Medium risk after confirming a warning and entering a reason.
- FR-06: Releasing a High risk hold requires the new Risk Override right. The release records user, timestamp and reason.
- FR-07: Risk fields, assessments and facts are visible on the Sales Order screen, read only.
- FR-08: An order whose risk is pending, missing or not recognised is imported, marked for review and blocked from delivery until the risk resolves.
- FR-09: The restriction is enforced in the order service, so the API and any background job are subject to it, not only the screen.
- FR-10: Risk hold behaviour is driven by settings: which levels hold, whether unknown risk blocks, and which right releases a hold.
- FR-11: A later risk update from Shopify re-evaluates an order that has not shipped yet.
- FR-12: Orders imported before go-live are not held retroactively.
- NFR-01: The risk evaluation adds no more than 10 percent to the import job's runtime at 1,000 orders per run, so the 10-minute schedule holds.
- NFR-02: No exception in risk mapping or persistence stops the import run or blocks the import of the order itself.
- NFR-03: Every hold release goes to the audit log with user, timestamp, previous and new status, and reason, retained for the chargeback dispute window.
- NFR-04: Risk state is communicated by text and label, not by colour alone.
